content: Prisma + pnpm/Turborepo pitfalls: generated client output location defaults to node_modules/.prisma inside pnpm's isolated store, which can break resolution from other workspace packages unless the client package is an explicit workspace dependency; recommended fix is a dedicated 'database'/'db' package that owns schema.prisma, runs prisma generate, and re-exports the client with an explicit 'output' path in the generator block. Multiple prisma schemas/clients in one monorepo can silently overwrite each other's generated output if paths collide. New developers who run turbo dev without first running the db:generate task hit type errors because the generated client doesn't exist yet — must wire generate into the build/dev task graph (turbo.json dependsOn) not just docs.
